mapping.time: Each observed 900-second source interval becomes one constant 10-second replay bin (90x acceleration).
mapping.mapping_interpretation: controller-independent experimental demand proxy, not observed HTTP traffic

time_scale_assessment.interpretation: Individual 10-second changes are at or below controller/metrics cadence; the run measures aggregate QoS/capacity under unresolved irregular forcing and cannot support precise per-change reaction-time or prediction claims.

chaotic_metrics_frozen.scale_event_rule: each observed change in desired replicas; direction from signed change
chaotic_metrics_frozen.oscillation_rule: a reversal when consecutive desired-replica changes have opposite signs and occur within 60 seconds
chaotic_metrics_frozen.possible_thrashing_rule: at least three such reversals inside any 120-second interval
chaotic_metrics_frozen.excess_low_capacity_rule: ready-pod-seconds above one replica during frozen low-demand bins
chaotic_metrics_frozen.tracking_rule: descriptive Pearson correlation of target RPS with ready replicas at lags 0,15,30,45,60 seconds; no causal/predictive interpretation
chaotic_metrics_frozen.undersupply_proxies: scheduled-request failures in spike bins plus readiness-deficit telemetry samples
chaotic_metrics_frozen.retention_rule: ready-pod-seconds above one replica in the 60 seconds after each high-to-low major change, reported descriptively

reset: Delete all HPA/PHPA objects and the app deployment, recreate the unchanged app, restart the PHPA operator only for Holt-Winters, then apply exactly one controller.
run_order_rationale: User-frozen order: soft HPA, Holt-Winters, tuned HPA.
